sources.title: Fine Tuning Large Language Model (LLM) - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Fine-tuning refers to the process of taking a pre-trained model and adapting it to a specific task by training it further on a smaller, domain-specific dataset. It refines the model's capabilities and improves its accuracy in specialised tasks without needing a massive dataset or expensive computational resources.
